title: feat(fields,components): optimize Lookup field popup with dynamic DataSource loading, keyboard nav, quick-create, and console integration
body:
Lookup field popup only rendered static `options` from field schema — when used with a real backend (ObjectStackAdapter), the dialog was empty since no options were passed. ### Changes - **Context DataSource resolution**: Reads DataSource from `SchemaRendererContext` automatically (same dynamic-require pattern as plugin-view), so lookup fields work out-of-the-box in forms (DrawerForm, ModalForm, etc.) without an explicit `dataSource` prop. Falls back through: explicit prop → `field.dataSource` → context → none. - **Form renderer DataSource propagation**: The form renderer in `@object-ui/components` now reads DataSource from `SchemaRendererContext` and passes it as a prop to all field widgets via `renderFieldComponent()`. This replaces the fragile `require('@object-ui/react')` pattern in field widgets, which failed in ESM/Vite production builds because `@object-ui/react` is ESM-only and not a dependency of `@object-ui/fields`. - **Nested field metadata unwrapping**: When LookupField is rendered inside a form via `createFieldRenderer`, the actual objectSchema field metadata (`reference_to`, `display_field`, etc.) is nested at `field.field` rather than at the top level. LookupField now detects and unwraps this nested structure so `reference_to` resolves correctly and `dataSource.find()` executes as expected. - **ObjectStack `reference` convention support**: The ObjectStack backend uses `reference` (not `reference_to`) as the property name for lookup field metadata. The codebase consistently uses `fieldDef.reference_to || fieldDef.reference` to handle both conventions, and LookupField now follows this same pattern — both for unwrapping nested field metadata detection and for resolving the target object name. - **Dynamic fetching**: When DataSource is available and `reference_to`/`reference` is set, dialog calls `DataSource.find(reference_to, { $top: 50, $search })` on open - **Debounced search**: 300ms debounce on search input, sends `$search` param to DataSource - **Record→Option mapping**: Maps raw records via `reference_field` (default: `name`), `id_field` (default: `_id`), and optional `description_field` with fallback chain (`record[field] → record.label → record.name → String(id)`) - **Secondary field display**: New `description_field` config shows subtitle/description text below each option label for richer UX - **Quick-create entry**: Optional `onCreateNew` callback renders a "Create new" button when no results are found and at the bottom of results - **Arrow key navigation**: Up/Down arrow keys to navigate options from the search input, Enter to select the active item, with auto-scroll into view - **Loading/error/empty states**: Spinner on initial load, inline spinner during search, error alert with retry, empty message - **Pagination hint**: "Showing X of Y results" when DataSource returns more than page size - **ARIA roles**: `role="listbox"` on options container, `role="option"` + `aria-selected` on each item - **Backward compatible**: Falls back to static `options` with local filtering when no DataSource provided - **Tailwind tokens**: Replaced hardcoded `bg-gray-100`/`bg-blue-50` with `bg-accent`/`text-accent-foreground` - **Documentation**: Updated `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` with all new features, schema interface, and dynamic DataSource examples ### Console Integration The key integration fix ensures LookupField works in the console app's ModalForm/DrawerForm: - `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` imports `SchemaRendererContext` from `@object-ui/react` and reads `dataSource` from context - The form's `renderFieldComponent()` now passes `dataSource` as a prop to all registered field widgets - LookupField unwraps nested field metadata from the `createFieldRenderer` wrapper — when the form passes field config, the actual objectSchema metadata (`reference_to`/`reference`, `reference_field`, etc.) is nested at `field.field`; LookupField detects this and reads from the inner object - LookupField supports both `reference_to` (types convention) and `reference` (ObjectStack backend convention) property names, matching the fallback pattern used across the codebase (RecordDetailView, DetailSection, RelatedList, etc.) - DataSource flow: `App.tsx (SchemaRendererProvider)` → `form.tsx (useContext → prop)` → `createFieldRenderer (wraps into field object)` → `LookupField (unwraps fieldMeta, reads dataSource)` ### Usage ```tsx // Static (unchanged behavior) // Dynamic — auto-resolves DataSource from SchemaRendererContext in forms // Dynamic with ObjectStack convention (reference instead of reference_to) // Dynamic with description field and quick-create openCreateDialog(query)} /> ``` ### Tests 14 new tests covering: fetch on open, loading state, error+retry, empty state, debounced `$search`, selection, static fallback, pagination hint, description field display, quick-create entry, arrow key navigation, nested field metadata resolution (createFieldRenderer wrapper scenario), ObjectStack `reference` convention (nested wrapper), and ObjectStack `reference` convention (flat field). All 23 complex widget tests pass.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 参考主流低代码平台，优化 Lookup 字段弹窗选择体验 > 参考主流低代码平台（如 Salesforce、Airtable、Retool 等），优化 objectui Lookup 字段弹窗选择体验，目前弹出窗口内没有加载任何数据（见截图）： > > > > --- > > ## 需求背景 > - 期望弹窗能展示关联字段的可选数据，支持搜索、筛选、分页，并具备友好的 UX 设计。 > - 当前弹窗界面为空，用户无法选择任何内容。 > > --- > > ## 参考主流低代码平台的优化项： > 1. 搜索与筛选：顶部提供快速模糊搜索过滤，支持大数据集分页或无限滚动。 > 2. 展示关键字段信息（如名称、标签、状态等），支持自定义列内容和渲染。 > 3. 最近/推荐项预选，优先显示常用与最近访问记录。 > 4. 新建记录快捷入口，无匹配结果时可直接新建并选中。 > 5. 键���导航、快捷操作（如回车选中）。 > 6. 加载、无结果、异常友好提示。 > > --- > > ## 建议方案 > - 接入 DataSource 动态加载 lookup 数据。 > - 支持 loading/error 状态与空态提示。 > - 最近项、快速新建入口。 > - 多字段显示与自定义渲染（如头像、标签等）。 > - 性能优化：分页、大量数据（虚拟列表）。 > - 对标 Salesforce、Retool、Airtable 体验。 > > --- > > ### 相关截图、文件 > - 截图见上 > - 涉及文件：`packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`、`content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx` > > --- > > 请根据以上主流低代码平台体验，规划技术方案并分阶段实现。 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
